headline: AG Strange Announces Federal Appeals Court Rejects Final Challenge to Alabama Payroll Deduction Law
snippet: 11th Circuit upheld SB2, ending AEA's five-year legal challenge.

headline: Taxpayer collection of union dues finally ends in Alabama
snippet: 11th Circuit upheld SB2 in 2016 after five years of litigation.

headline: AEA wins injunction over state's payroll deduction ban
snippet: Federal court injunction two days before SB2 took effect, finding it likely overbroad.
